title: Pulse techniques and apparatus, Part 1: Pulse terms and definitions
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 1) provides fundamental definitions for general use in time domain pulse technology. It defines terms for pulse phenomena and pulse characteristics which are prerequisite to: — efficient communication of technical infonnationj — standards for methods of pulse characteristic measurement, — standards for pulse apparatus, and — standards for apparatus which employ pulse techniques.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
